name: Potassium Deficiency
description: Potassium regulates water balance, enzyme activation, and fruit quality. Deficiency typically appears as scorching or browning of leaf margins and reduced fruit quality.
symptoms: Yellowing and scorching of leaf margins and tips (marginal necrosis)
Weak stems and lodging in cereals
Poor fruit development and small fruit size
treatments: Apply potassium fertilizer (potassium chloride, potassium sulfate, NPK)
Foliar spray of potassium sulfate (1%) for foliar feeding
Apply wood ash as organic potassium source
Use potassium nitrate for both K and N supply
prevention: Incorporate organic matter and crop residues
Use split applications of potassium on sandy soils
